name: Enbou no Felshis ~Horizon of the Earth and Sky~
original_name: 遠望のフェルシス Horizon of the earth and sky
source:
The Emilia Republic is situated on the northeast area of the Reindil continent. In the eastern town of Felshis is Voromia National Academy, which is well-known for training adventurers. Adventurers specialize in searching for and retrieving an important resource to all nations: dragon bones. Many young people aspire to be adventurers for different reasons: to satiate their curiosity, to become rich, to follow in their ancestors’ footsteps, to envision a world they have never seen.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
艾米利亚共和国位于雷因迪尔大陆东北部。在东部城市费尔希斯，坐落着以培养冒险者闻名的沃罗米亚国立学院。冒险者专门寻找并回收对各国都至关重要的资源——龙骨。许多年轻人怀着不同目的立志成为冒险者：满足好奇心、积累财富、追随祖先足迹，或亲眼见识从未看过的世界。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
